title: MSFS 2024 Marketplace Update: 9 NEW airports you’ll want to fly this week!
description:
🔍 Description
The Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace Update for February 7, 2026 is here, and this week is packed with some truly must‑have new airports for PC flyers! From Rome Fiumicino to Newcastle International and several standout U.S. fields, this is a fantastic week for scenery hunters.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 RW Profiles: EGNT Newcastle International Airport (A detailed major UK regional hub)
🛫 NMG Simulations: FARB Richards Bay Airport (South Africa coastal airport)
🛫 NMG Simulations: FAYP Ysterplaat AFB (Historic South African Air Force base)
🛫 HRSimYard: HEMS Innsbruck (Rescue‑focused heliport scenery)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KMMV McMinnville Municipal Airport (Home of the Spruce Goose!)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KRST Rochester International Airport (U.S. Midwest regional hub)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KSAF Santa Fe Municipal Airport (Great for Southwest flying)
🛫 msfscenerybuilders: KTXK Texarkana Regional Airport (Cross‑state regional airport)
🛫 MK‑STUDIOS: LIRF Rome Fiumicino International Airport (Major European international mega‑hub)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 Dreamscenery: Bismarck (ND) New Lights 2024 Exclusive Edition (Enhanced night environment)
🌆 Dreamscenery: KAUS Airport Lights 2024 Edition (Austin lighting overhaul)
🌆 Dreamscenery: KBWI Airport Lights 2024 Edition (Baltimore improved lighting)
🌆 Dreamscenery: KLAS Airport Lights 2024 Edition (Las Vegas lighting upgrade)

If you enjoyed this roundup, don’t forget to like the video, subscribe for weekly updates, and drop a comment about which airport you’re flying to first!
Thanks for watching, and as always

✈️ See you in the skies!
